title: Contrapunctus XIV (unfinished)

captions.text: ☞ Subject I alone, in the bass, in long notes.
☞ The answer in the tenor, on A.
☞ Stretto: subject I inverted in the bass, then upright above it.
☞ Subject II in the alto: a new running line, in eighths.
☞ Subject II in the soprano, now with subject I in the bass.
☞ Subject III in the tenor: B♭ A C B♮, in German B-A-C-H, Bach's name.
☞ Stretto: B-A-C-H in the alto, on F, while the tenor goes on.
☞ Subject III inverted in the alto.
☞ All three subjects together: II in the alto, I in the bass, then III.
☞ B-A-C-H in the tenor; soon after, the manuscript breaks off.

listenFor: three subjects, the third spelling B-A-C-H; it breaks off unfinished
